findings.message: Lock held in an improper manner
findings.reason: Reveal/Rate mutate the shared cached session under a valid common lock, but BuildViewModel read it outside that lock. A concurrent rating produced a mixed response (old current card, advanced index/counts), and the double index read could race past the last card. Response construction now holds the same lock; deterministic regression failed before and passes after.
findings.verificationScope: Current application/source flow; runtime probes where applicable
